title: Petersglocke (Cologne Cathedral)

place.label: South tower, Cologne Cathedral
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

maker: Heinrich Ulrich, Gebr. Ulrich foundry, Apolda

timeline.event: Predecessor Kaiserglocke cast by Andreas Hamm
New bell ordered from Gebr. Ulrich, Apolda
Cast by Heinrich Ulrich (the inscription says 1922)

tiers.everyday: The Petersglocke in Cologne Cathedral weighs 24 tonnes. It replaced the Kaiserglocke, which was melted down in 1918.
tiers.student: The cathedral records an order of 13 March 1922 to Gebr. Ulrich in Apolda and casting on 5 May 1923 by Heinrich Ulrich: 24,000 kg, 3.22 m across, 3.2 m high, note c0, clapper about 600 kg.
